Housing and services for your consultants in Paris

A three- to twelve-month engagement with a Paris client deserves better than a hotel room. So do your consultants.

What we do for consulting firms

A consultant's comfort shows in their work. And in how long they stay with the firm.

An apartment near the client
We start from the engagement address and search within thirty minutes of it, with a workspace and reliable wifi.
Flexibility
The engagement runs long, ends early or moves site: we adjust the housing without penalising your consultant.
One quote per engagement
Housing, transport and services on a single document, which makes rebilling to your client straightforward.
Services that keep your people fresh
Gym, concierge, welcome: on a long engagement, this is what prevents burnout.

Questions from consulting firms

Can you house a consultant who flies home at weekends?

Yes. We propose formats suited to Monday-to-Thursday presence, either keeping the apartment for the whole engagement or a hotel solution, depending on the rhythm.

Can you handle several engagements for the same firm?

That is our daily work. You have one contact for all your engagements in the Paris region and a clear view of what is booked for whom.

The simplest way: call us

In ten minutes we will understand your needs and tell you what we can do. In English or French. We are in Paris, Central European Time.
